title: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2005

sections.shortTitle: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIII OF 2005
National Database And Registration
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to amend the National Database and
Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd
August, 2005]
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the National Database and Registration Authority
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: National Database And Registration Authority Amendment Ordinance 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance VIII of 2000

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2005
ORDINANCE XIII OF 2005
National Database And Registration
Authority (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance to amend the National Database and
Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd
August, 2005]
2. Amendment of section 3,
Ordinance VIII of 2000.---(1) In the National Database and
Registration Authority Ordinance, 2000 (VIII of 2000), hereinafter referred to
as the said Ordinance, in section 3,--‑
(a) in subsection (3),--‑
(b) after the word
"and" the words "not less than" shall be inserted; and
(ii) in the proviso, for the full
stop, at the end, a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following
further proviso shall be added, namely:--‑
"Provided further that the
Federal Government may, from time to time, by Notification in the official
Gazette, increase or decrease the number of members and prescribe mode of their
appointment as it may deem fit."; and
(b) in subsection (5), for the
words "such shorter term not exceeding one year", the words "a
similar term or terms" shall be substituted; and
(c) in subsection (8), for the
colon a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso shall be omitted.
